title: I Have Calmed and Quieted My Soul

questions.question: O Lord, my heart is not lifted up; my eyes are not raised too what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 131:1 (ESV): "O Lord, my heart is not lifted up; my eyes are not raised too high;"

questions.question: I do not occupy myself with things too great and too what for me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 131:1 (ESV): "...too great and too marvelous for me."

questions.question: But I have calmed and quieted my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 131:2 (ESV): "But I have calmed and quieted my soul,"

questions.question: Like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child is my soul within whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 131:2 (ESV): "like a weaned child is my soul within me."

questions.question: O Israel, hope in the Lord from this time forth and how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 131:3 (ESV): "O Israel, hope in the Lord from this time forth and forevermore."

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 131?
questions.explanation: Psalm 131 Title: "A Song of Ascents. Of David."

questions.question: The Psalmist compares his soul to a what?
The attitude described in verse 1 is one of what?
questions.explanation: Not lifted up heart or high eyes signifies humility.

questions.question: How many verses are in Psalm 131?
questions.explanation: It is a short psalm of 3 verses.

questions.question: What is not raised too high?
questions.explanation: Psalm 131:1 (ESV): "...my eyes are not raised too high;"

questions.question: What does a "weaned child" signify in this context?
options: Contentment and trust not based on immediate gratification
questions.correctAnswer: Contentment and trust not based on immediate gratification
questions.explanation: A nursing child cries for milk; a weaned child rests with its mother.

questions.question: What does "occupy myself" refer to in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Hebrew "halak" typically means walk, used metaphorically for conduct.

questions.question: What are the "things too great and too marvelous"?
options: Matters beyond human understanding or station
questions.correctAnswer: Matters beyond human understanding or station
questions.explanation: Implies areas reserved for God or leaders, not for the humble worshiper.

questions.question: Who is called to hope in the Lord?
questions.explanation: Psalm 131:3 (ESV): "O Israel, hope in the Lord..."

questions.question: Instead of being anxious or ambitious, the soul is what?

key_verse_text: But I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child is my soul within me.
